title: Safeguard Fine-Tuned LLMs Through Pre- and Post-Tuning Model Merging
reasoning: The paper focuses on AI safety and the technical problem of 'safety degradation' during fine-tuning. While it discusses aligning models with human values, its evaluations are centered on 'safety refusal' (blocking harmful instructions like malware or illegal acts) using benchmarks like AdvBench and HEx-PHI, rather than evaluating religious beliefs, moral philosophy, or ethical reasoning frameworks.
